description: This file is a test script for Git's fsck functionality, containing various test cases to verify object integrity, consistency, and error handling in Git repositories.

methods.name: sha1_file
methods.description: Returns the path to the object file based on its hash.

methods.name: remove_object
methods.description: Removes the specified object file from the Git objects directory.

methods.name: corrupt_index_checksum
methods.description: Perl script that corrupts the checksum at the end of the Git index file.

methods.name: create_repo_missing
methods.description: Creates a Git repository with specific objects missing to test fsck's detection of missing objects.

methods.name: corrupt_graph_obj
methods.description: Corrupts the object in a commit-graph repository to test fsck's handling of corrupted commit graphs.
